shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone slab/panel
registers or horizontal banding dividing the surface
repeated row of similar motifs across the top
raised arms/forelimbs bent at the elbow
justification: Both are low-relief panels organised into horizontal registers with a repeated row of motifs along the top and profile-oriented subjects, but A depicts two naturalistically modelled human figures in elaborate garments confronting each other with a bowl and drinking tube, while B depicts schematic animals (a crouching quadruped, bird-like creatures, a large long-necked bird) and abstract signs with no human figures. The proportions, anatomical detailing and narrative confrontation of A have no counterpart in B's flat, outline-driven animal iconography, so only very generic features are shared.
